# The canary of the CI job `supply-chain` (plan d454fd62, step 109; roadmap row 0.10).
#
# These are old releases with published security advisories, and that is their whole job:
# `pip-audit -r tests/fixtures/canary-vulnerable-pins.txt --no-deps --disable-pip` must exit 1
# with a non-empty report on every CI run. If it does not, the audit itself is broken (an
# unreachable advisory service, a changed exit code, a withdrawn advisory) and the build fails,
# so a green `pip-audit --skip-editable` over the real environment can be believed.
#
# NEVER install, upgrade or "fix" these pins: they are vulnerable on purpose, only audited, never
# resolved or installed (`--no-deps --disable-pip`). They are three packages so the canary stays
# red if one advisory is withdrawn. Not part of `constraints.txt`, the dev extra or any extra.
pyyaml==5.3.1
jinja2==2.11.2
urllib3==1.26.4
